crossRefs.note: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was…
The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.
Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.
translations.bsb: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
translations.kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
translations.asv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
